recipes.title: Kedgeree
steps: Poach the haddock in water for 5 minutes and flake; use the water to cook the rice.
Cook the onion in the butter for 6 minutes and add the curry powder.
Fold in the rice and fish, top with halved eggs and parsley and serve with lemon.

recipes.title: Cioppino
steps: Cook the onion and fennel in the oil for 8 minutes, add the garlic and pepper flakes.
Add the wine, tomatoes and stock and simmer 20 minutes.
Add the fish, shrimp and mussels, cover and cook 5 to 6 minutes until the mussels open; finish with parsley and serve with bread.

recipes.title: Salmon en Papillote
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C (400 °F).
Lay each fillet on a sheet of parchment with the vegetables, lemon, dill, butter, wine and salt.
Fold and crimp tightly into parcels and bake for 12 to 15 minutes; open at the table.

recipes.title: Sardines on Toast with Tomatoes
steps: Toast the bread and rub with the cut garlic.
Top with tomato and the sardines.
Finish with lemon, parsley and chili flakes.

recipes.title: Bouillabaisse-Style Fish Stew
steps: Cook the onion, leek and fennel in the oil for 10 minutes, add the garlic, tomatoes, saffron and orange zest.
Add the stock and simmer 20 minutes.
Add the fish and mussels and simmer 6 to 8 minutes; serve with toasts spread with aioli.

recipes.title: Dark Chocolate Mousse
steps: Melt the chocolate and cool slightly, then stir in the yolks.
Whip the cream to soft peaks and fold in.
Whisk the whites with the salt and sugar to soft peaks and fold in gently.
Spoon into glasses and chill 3 hours; it contains raw egg.

recipes.title: Lemon Mousse
steps: Whisk the condensed milk with the lemon juice and zest until it thickens.
Whip the cream to soft peaks and fold in.
Spoon into glasses and chill 2 hours.

recipes.title: Chocolate Bark with Nuts and Fruit
steps: Melt the chocolate gently.
Spread thinly on a parchment-lined tray.
Scatter with the nuts, cranberries and salt, chill until set and break into pieces.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Fudge
steps: Melt the peanut butter and butter together.
Stir in the powdered sugar and vanilla until smooth.
Press into a lined 20 cm (8-inch) tin, chill 2 hours and cut into squares.

recipes.title: Classic Pavlova
steps: Heat the oven to 120 °C (250 °F).
Whisk the whites to stiff peaks, then add the sugar a spoon at a time until glossy; fold in the vinegar and cornstarch.
Spread into a 20 cm round on parchment and bake 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 hours; cool in the oven.
Top with whipped cream and fruit just before serving.

recipes.title: Key Lime Bars
steps: Heat the oven to 175 °C (350 °F).
Press the crumbs, butter and sugar into a lined 20 cm (8-inch) tin and bake 10 minutes.
Whisk the condensed milk, yolks, lime juice and zest, pour over and bake 15 to 18 minutes until set.
Cool and chill 3 hours before cutting.

recipes.title: Baked Apples with Oats and Cinnamon
steps: Heat the oven to 180 °C (350 °F).
Mix the oats, sugar, butter, cinnamon and raisins and pack into the apples.
Stand in a dish with the juice and bake 30 to 35 minutes until tender.

recipes.title: Strawberry Sorbet
steps: Dissolve the sugar in the water over heat and cool.
Blend with the strawberries and lemon juice and strain.
Churn in an ice-cream machine, or freeze in a tub and stir with a fork every 45 minutes for 3 hours.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chia Pudding
steps: Whisk the cocoa, maple syrup and vanilla into the milk.
Stir in the chia, wait 10 minutes and whisk again.
Chill overnight and serve with fruit.

recipes.title: Meringue Kisses
steps: Heat the oven to 100 °C (210 °F).
Whisk the whites and cream of tartar to soft peaks, then add the sugar gradually until stiff and glossy; add the vanilla.
Pipe small kisses onto parchment and bake 1 hour, then cool in the oven.

recipes.title: Almond Biscotti
steps: Heat the oven to 175 °C (350 °F).
Mix the dry ingredients, add the eggs and extract, then the almonds, to a sticky dough.
Shape two logs and bake 25 minutes; cool 10 minutes, slice diagonally and bake the slices 10 minutes per side until crisp.

recipes.title: Blueberry Cobbler
steps: Heat the oven to 190 °C (375 °F).
Toss the berries with half the sugar, lemon and cornstarch in a dish.
Rub the butter into the flour, baking powder, salt and the rest of the sugar, stir in the buttermilk and drop spoonfuls over the fruit.
Bake 35 to 40 minutes until golden and bubbling.

recipes.title: Peach Crisp
steps: Heat the oven to 180 °C (350 °F).
Toss the peaches with the sugar and cornstarch in a dish.
Rub the oats, flour, brown sugar, butter and cinnamon to a crumble and scatter over.
Bake 35 to 40 minutes until golden.

recipes.title: Vanilla Custard
steps: Heat the milk until steaming.
Whisk the yolks, sugar and cornstarch, pour on the hot milk while whisking and return to the pan.
Stir over low heat until it coats a spoon; add the vanilla.

recipes.title: Cannoli Dip
steps: Beat the ricotta, mascarpone, sugar, vanilla and zest until smooth.
Fold in the chocolate chips.
Chill and serve with broken waffle cones or biscuits.

recipes.title: S'mores Bars
steps: Heat the oven to 175 °C (350 °F).
Press the crumbs, butter and sugar into a lined 20 cm (8-inch) tin and bake 10 minutes.
Scatter with chocolate and marshmallows and bake 8 to 10 minutes until puffed; cool before cutting.

recipes.title: Crispy Rice Cereal Treats
steps: Melt the butter and marshmallows over low heat, stirring.
Stir in the vanilla and cereal until coated.
Press into a buttered tin, cool and cut.

recipes.title: Gulab Jamun
steps: Simmer the sugar, water and cardamom 5 minutes and add the rose water.
Mix the milk powder, flour, soda, ghee and milk to a soft dough and roll 16 smooth balls.
Fry gently at about 150 °C, turning, for 6 to 8 minutes until deep brown.
Soak in the warm syrup for at least 1 hour.

recipes.title: Kheer (Indian Rice Pudding)
steps: Rinse the rice and simmer in the milk with the cardamom, stirring often, for 35 to 40 minutes until creamy.
Stir in the sugar and saffron and cook 5 minutes.
Serve warm or chilled with the nuts.

recipes.title: Basque Burnt Cheesecake
steps: Heat the oven to 220 °C (425 °F) and line a 23 cm (9-inch) springform with crumpled parchment.
Beat the cream cheese and sugar, then the eggs one at a time, then the cream; sift in the flour and salt.
Bake 45 to 55 minutes until deeply browned with a wobbly centre.
Cool completely, then chill before slicing.

recipes.title: Apple Strudel
steps: Heat the oven to 190 °C (375 °F).
Toss the apples with the sugar, cinnamon, raisins and lemon juice.
Layer the phyllo, brushing each sheet with butter and scattering with crumbs, spread the apples along one edge and roll up.
Brush with butter and bake 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.title: French Madeleines
steps: Whisk the eggs and sugar until pale and thick.
Fold in the flour, baking powder, zest and butter and chill the batter 1 hour.
Spoon into buttered madeleine tins and bake at 200 °C (400 °F) for 9 to 11 minutes until domed.

recipes.title: Crepes Suzette
steps: Melt the butter and sugar in a wide pan until lightly caramel.
Add the orange zest and juice and simmer to a syrup.
Fold the crepes into quarters, warm them in the sauce and add the liqueur if using.

recipes.title: Dorayaki
steps: Whisk the eggs, sugar and honey, then the flour, baking powder and water to a thick batter; rest 15 minutes.
Cook 12 small pancakes in a lightly oiled pan over low heat until golden.
Sandwich pairs with the red bean paste.

recipes.title: Brigadeiros
steps: Cook the condensed milk, cocoa and butter over low heat, stirring constantly, for 10 to 15 minutes until it pulls away from the pan.
Cool on a plate.
With buttered hands roll into small balls and coat in sprinkles.

recipes.title: Alfajores
steps: Beat the butter and sugar, add the yolks and vanilla, then the cornstarch, flour and baking powder to a soft dough; chill 30 minutes.
Roll 5 mm thick, cut 30 rounds and bake at 175 °C (350 °F) for 10 to 12 minutes without browning.
Sandwich with dulce de leche and roll the edges in coconut.

recipes.title: Portuguese Custard Tarts
steps: Heat the oven to its hottest, 250 °C (480 °F) or more.
Roll the pastry into a log, cut 12 slices and press each into a muffin cup.
Cook the milk, sugar, cornstarch, cinnamon and lemon peel until thick, cool slightly, remove the peel and stick and whisk in the yolks and vanilla.
Fill the cases and bake 15 to 20 minutes until blistered.

recipes.title: Hummingbird Cake
steps: Heat the oven to 175 °C (350 °F) and line two 23 cm (9-inch) tins.
Whisk the dry ingredients, then stir in the eggs, oil, bananas, pineapple and pecans.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes, cool and sandwich and top with the frosting.

recipes.title: Marble Cake
steps: Heat the oven to 175 °C (350 °F) and butter a loaf or bundt tin.
Beat the butter and sugar, add the eggs, then fold in the flour, baking powder, milk and vanilla.
Stir the cocoa and 2 tbsp milk into a third of the batter; layer the batters and swirl with a knife.
Bake 45 to 50 minutes.

recipes.title: Italian Olive Oil Cake
steps: Heat the oven to 175 °C (350 °F) and line a 23 cm (9-inch) tin.
Whisk the eggs and sugar until pale, then the oil, milk and zest.
Fold in the flour, baking powder and salt and bake 40 to 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Tahini Halva
steps: Warm the tahini gently.
Boil the sugar and water to 118 °C (245 °F), the soft-ball stage.
Pour the syrup into the tahini with the vanilla and pistachios and stir just until it thickens.
Press into a lined tin and cool completely before cutting.

recipes.title: Mochi with Sweet Red Bean
steps: Mix the rice flour, sugar and water smooth in a microwave-safe bowl.
Microwave covered for 1 minute, stir, then 1 minute more and 30 seconds more until translucent.
Turn onto cornstarch, divide into 12, flatten and wrap each round a ball of bean paste.

recipes.title: Gluten-Free Almond Cake
steps: Heat the oven to 175 °C (350 °F) and line a 20 cm (8-inch) tin.
Whisk the eggs and sugar until pale and thick, then fold in the almond flour, zest and baking powder.
Bake 35 to 40 minutes, cool and dust with powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Gluten-Free Fudgy Brownies
steps: Heat the oven to 175 °C (350 °F) and line a 20 cm (8-inch) tin.
Melt the chocolate and butter, whisk in the sugar, then the eggs.
Fold in the almond flour, cocoa and salt and bake 22 to 25 minutes; cool before cutting.

recipes.title: Vegan Banana Bread
steps: Heat the oven to 175 °C (350 °F) and line a loaf tin.
Whisk the bananas, oil, sugar, milk and vanilla.
Fold in the flour, soda, cinnamon, salt and walnuts.
Bake 50 to 55 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.

recipes.title: Vegan Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 180 °C (350 °F).
Beat the vegan butter and sugars, then the milk and vanilla.
Mix in the flour, soda and salt, then the chips.
Roll 20 balls and bake 10 to 12 minutes; cool on the tray.

recipes.title: Flourless Peanut Butter Cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 175 °C (350 °F).
Mix everything to a dough.
Roll 16 balls, press with a fork and bake 9 to 10 minutes; they firm up as they cool (gluten-free if your baking soda and peanut butter are).

recipes.title: Almond Flour Blueberry Muffins
steps: Heat the oven to 175 °C (350 °F) and line a muffin tin.
Whisk the eggs, maple syrup, oil, vanilla and lemon juice, then stir in the almond flour and soda.
Fold in the blueberries and bake 20 to 22 minutes.

recipes.title: Vegan Blueberry Muffins
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C (400 °F) and line a muffin tin.
Stir the vinegar into the milk and leave 5 minutes.
Whisk the dry ingredients, add the milk, oil and vanilla and stir just to combine; fold in the berries.
Bake 20 to 22 minutes.

recipes.title: Gluten-Free Fluffy Pancakes
steps: Whisk the flour, baking powder, sugar and salt.
Whisk in the eggs, milk and butter and rest 5 minutes.
Cook ladlefuls in a buttered pan over medium heat for 2 minutes per side.

recipes.title: Oat Flour Banana Muffins
steps: Heat the oven to 180 °C (350 °F) and line a muffin tin.
Whisk the bananas, eggs, maple syrup and oil.
Stir in the oat flour, soda, cinnamon and salt and bake 20 to 22 minutes; use certified gluten-free oat flour if you need them gluten-free.

recipes.title: Coconut Flour Pancakes
steps: Whisk everything except the oil and rest 5 minutes to thicken.
Cook small pancakes in the oil over medium-low heat for 2 to 3 minutes per side; they are delicate, so flip gently.

recipes.title: Vegan Carrot Cake
steps: Heat the oven to 175 °C (350 °F) and line a 23 cm (9-inch) tin.
Whisk the dry ingredients, then stir in the carrots, oil, milk, vinegar and walnuts.
Bake 35 to 40 minutes and cool.
Beat the vegan cream cheese with the powdered sugar and spread on top.

recipes.title: Gluten-Free Lemon Bars
steps: Heat the oven to 175 °C (350 °F) and line a 20 cm (8-inch) tin.
Press the almond flour, 30 g cornstarch, butter and powdered sugar into the tin and bake 15 minutes.
Whisk the eggs, sugar, lemon and 2 tbsp cornstarch, pour over and bake 20 to 25 minutes until set; chill before cutting.

recipes.title: Gluten-Free Banana Bread
steps: Heat the oven to 175 °C (350 °F) and line a loaf tin.
Whisk the bananas, eggs, oil and sugar.
Fold in the flours, soda, cinnamon and salt and bake 50 to 55 minutes.

recipes.title: Vegan Fudgy Brownies
steps: Heat the oven to 175 °C (350 °F) and line a 20 cm (8-inch) tin.
Melt the chocolate with the oil, then whisk in the sugar, aquafaba and vanilla.
Fold in the flour, cocoa and salt and bake 22 to 25 minutes; cool fully before cutting.

recipes.title: Raspberry Almond Bars
steps: Heat the oven to 175 °C (350 °F) and line a 20 cm (8-inch) tin.
Mix the almond flour, oats, maple syrup, oil, extract and salt and press two thirds into the tin.
Spread with the jam, crumble over the rest with the almonds and bake 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cookie Bars
steps: Heat the oven to 175 °C (350 °F) and line a 20 cm (8-inch) tin.
Whisk the butter, sugar, egg and vanilla, then stir in the rest.
Press into the tin and bake 22 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Gluten-Free Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 180 °C (350 °F).
Beat the butter and sugars, then the egg and vanilla.
Mix in the flour, xanthan gum (skip if your blend has it), soda and salt, then the chips; chill 30 minutes.
Roll 20 balls and bake 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Vegan Oat Flapjacks
steps: Heat the oven to 180 °C (350 °F) and line a 20 cm (8-inch) tin.
Melt the vegan butter, sugar and syrup, then stir in the oats and salt.
Press into the tin and bake 20 to 25 minutes; cut while warm, then cool in the tin.

recipes.title: Gluten-Free Cornbread
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C (400 °F) and grease a 20 cm (8-inch) tin.
Whisk the dry ingredients, then stir in the eggs, buttermilk and butter.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes until golden.

recipes.title: Savory Oatmeal with Fried Egg
steps: Simmer the oats in the salted water for 5 minutes until creamy.
Fry the eggs in the oil until the edges crisp.
Spoon the oats into bowls, top with the eggs and green onions and drizzle with soy sauce and sesame oil.

recipes.title: Tofu Breakfast Tacos
steps: Soften the onion in the oil over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Add the tofu, turmeric, cumin and salt and cook 5 minutes until hot and lightly golden.
Warm the tortillas and fill with the tofu, avocado and salsa.

recipes.title: Chickpea Flour Omelette
steps: Whisk the chickpea flour, water, turmeric, baking powder and salt to a smooth batter and rest 5 minutes.
Stir in the onion, tomato, cilantro and chili.
Pour half into a hot oiled frying pan, cook 3 minutes, flip and cook 2 minutes; repeat.

recipes.title: Huevos Divorciados
steps: Warm the beans and the two salsas in separate pans.
Lightly fry the tortillas in the oil and lay two on each plate.
Fry the eggs and set two on each plate.
Spoon green salsa over one egg and red over the other, add beans and crumble over the cheese.

recipes.title: Turkish Eggs with Garlic Yogurt (Cilbir)
steps: Stir the garlic and salt into the yogurt and spread over two plates.
Poach the eggs in simmering water with the vinegar for 3 to 4 minutes.
Melt the butter with the aleppo pepper until foaming.
Set the eggs on the yogurt, spoon over the butter, scatter with dill and serve with toast.

recipes.title: Breakfast Burrito Bowls
steps: Fry the potatoes in the oil with the chili powder and salt over medium heat for 15 minutes, adding the pepper for the last 5.
Warm the beans.
Scramble the eggs softly.
Divide into bowls and top with cheese, salsa and avocado.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Spice Oatmeal
steps: Simmer the oats in the milk for 5 minutes, stirring.
Stir in the pumpkin, maple syrup and spice and heat through.
Serve topped with pecans.

recipes.title: Ham and Cheese Croissant Bake
steps: Butter a baking dish and scatter in the croissants, ham and most of the cheese.
Whisk the eggs, milk, mustard and pepper, pour over and leave 15 minutes.
Top with the rest of the cheese and bake at 180 °C (350 °F) for 30 to 35 minutes until set.

recipes.title: Cinnamon French Toast Casserole
steps: Put the bread in a buttered dish.
Whisk the eggs, milk, half the sugar, cinnamon and vanilla, pour over and chill at least 1 hour or overnight.
Drizzle with the butter, sprinkle with the remaining sugar and bake at 175 °C (350 °F) for 40 to 45 minutes.
Serve with maple syrup.

recipes.title: Egg and Vegetable Breakfast Fried Rice
steps: Scramble the eggs in half the oil in a hot wok and set aside.
Stir-fry the peas in the rest of the oil for 2 minutes, then add the rice and toss over high heat for 4 minutes.
Return the eggs with the soy sauce, sesame oil and green onions.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Toast with Almond Butter
steps: Cut the sweet potato lengthways into 1 cm slices.
Toast them in a toaster on high for 3 or 4 cycles, or roast at 200 °C (400 °F) for 15 minutes, until tender.
Spread with almond butter and top with banana, cinnamon and honey.

recipes.title: Banana Bread Overnight Oats
steps: Mix the oats, milk, yogurt, banana, maple syrup and cinnamon in two jars.
Chill overnight.
Top with walnuts before eating.

recipes.title: Savory Cottage Cheese Bowl
steps: Spoon the cottage cheese into a bowl.
Top with the tomatoes and cucumber.
Drizzle with oil and sprinkle with seasoning and pepper.

recipes.title: Green Shakshuka
steps: Soften the leek and zucchini in the oil over medium heat for 6 minutes.
Add the garlic, cumin, kale and spinach and cook until wilted.
Make 6 hollows, crack in the eggs, cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 minutes.
Crumble over the feta.

recipes.title: Spinach and Cheese Breakfast Strata
steps: Layer the bread, spinach and cheese in a buttered dish.
Whisk the eggs, milk, mustard and salt and pour over; chill at least 2 hours.
Bake at 175 °C (350 °F) for 45 to 50 minutes until puffed and set.

recipes.title: Kaya Toast with Soft Eggs
steps: Lower the eggs into boiling water, turn off the heat, cover and leave 6 minutes.
Toast the bread, spread with kaya and sandwich with thin slices of butter.
Crack the eggs into bowls and season with soy sauce and pepper to dip.

recipes.title: Egg Bhurji (Indian Scrambled Eggs)
steps: Soften the onion in the butter for 5 minutes, then add the chili, tomato, turmeric and salt and cook 3 minutes.
Add the beaten eggs and stir over low heat until softly set.
Finish with garam masala and cilantro and serve with flatbread or toast.

recipes.title: Tamago Kake Gohan (Egg over Rice)
steps: Put the steaming rice in a bowl and make a well.
Crack in the egg, add the soy sauce and stir quickly so the heat of the rice lightly cooks the egg.
Top with green onion and furikake; use only very fresh, high-quality eggs as the egg stays partly raw.

recipes.title: Rava Upma
steps: Toast the semolina in a dry pan until fragrant and set aside.
Fry the mustard seeds, dal and curry leaves in the ghee until they crackle, then the onion, chili and ginger for 4 minutes.
Add the water and salt and bring to a boil, then rain in the semolina while stirring and cook 2 to 3 minutes.
Cover off the heat for 2 minutes and finish with cilantro.

recipes.title: Tex-Mex Migas
steps: Fry the tortilla strips in the oil until crisp and set aside.
Soften the onion and jalapeno 3 minutes, add the tomato.
Add the beaten eggs and the strips and stir until softly set.
Top with the cheese.

recipes.title: Onion Uttapam
steps: Heat a lightly oiled frying pan over medium heat.
Spread a ladle of batter into a thick 15 cm round.
Scatter with onion, tomato, chili and cilantro and press in lightly.
Drizzle with oil, cook 3 minutes, flip and cook 2 minutes; repeat.

recipes.title: Broccoli Crunch Salad with Bacon
steps: Whisk the mayonnaise, vinegar and honey.
Toss with the broccoli, onion, cranberries and seeds.
Chill 30 minutes and top with the bacon.

recipes.title: Japanese Cucumber Sunomono
steps: Toss the cucumber with the salt, leave 10 minutes and squeeze dry.
Stir the vinegar, sugar and soy sauce until the sugar dissolves.
Toss with the cucumber and wakame and sprinkle with sesame.

recipes.title: Endive, Pear and Blue Cheese Salad
steps: Whisk the oil, vinegar, honey and salt.
Arrange the endive and pear on a platter.
Scatter with crumbled cheese and walnuts and drizzle with the dressing.

recipes.title: Roasted Sweet Potato and Kale Salad
steps: Roast the sweet potato and chickpeas with 2 tbsp oil and salt at 210 °C (410 °F) for 25 minutes.
Massage the kale with the rest of the oil and a pinch of salt.
Whisk the tahini, lemon juice, maple syrup and water to a pourable dressing.
Toss everything together and scatter with seeds.

recipes.title: Carrot Ginger Sesame Salad
steps: Whisk the ginger, vinegar, soy sauce, sesame oil and honey.
Toss with the carrots.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and cilantro.

recipes.title: Classic Tuna Salad
steps: Flake the tuna into a bowl.
Mix in the mayonnaise, celery, onion, lemon, relish and pepper.
Serve on lettuce, crackers or in sandwiches.

recipes.title: Beef Taco Salad
steps: Brown the beef with the taco seasoning and a splash of water.
Divide the lettuce, tomatoes and beans between bowls.
Top with the beef, cheese and broken chips.
Thin the sour cream with the salsa and spoon over.

recipes.title: Corn and Tomato Salad with Basil
steps: Blanch the corn kernels for 2 minutes and cool, or use raw if very fresh.
Toss with the tomatoes, onion, oil, vinegar and salt.
Tear in the basil just before serving.

recipes.title: Spinach Salad with Warm Bacon Dressing
steps: Fry the bacon until crisp, lift out and keep 3 tbsp of the fat in the pan.
Whisk the vinegar, mustard and sugar into the warm fat.
Toss the spinach, mushrooms and onion with the warm dressing and top with bacon and sliced egg.

recipes.title: Grilled Halloumi and Watermelon Salad
steps: Grill or fry the halloumi in a dry pan for 1 to 2 minutes per side until golden.
Toss the watermelon, cucumber and mint with the oil and lime juice.
Top with the warm halloumi.

recipes.title: Burrata with Heirloom Tomatoes
steps: Arrange the tomatoes on a platter and season with salt.
Set the burrata in the middle and tear it open.
Drizzle with oil and balsamic and scatter with basil; serve with bread.

recipes.title: Shaved Brussels Sprout Salad
steps: Whisk the oil, lemon juice, mustard and salt.
Toss with the shaved sprouts and leave 10 minutes to soften.
Add the parmesan, almonds and cranberries.

recipes.title: Celery, Apple and Walnut Salad
steps: Toss the celery and apple with the lemon juice straight away so the apple stays pale.
Add the oil, salt, parsley and walnuts.
Top with the parmesan.

recipes.title: Radish and Cucumber Yogurt Salad
steps: Stir the garlic, lemon and salt into the yogurt.
Fold in the radishes and cucumber.
Scatter with dill and serve cold.

recipes.title: Asparagus and Egg Salad
steps: Boil the eggs 9 minutes, cool and chop.
Blanch the asparagus 2 to 3 minutes and cool in iced water.
Whisk the oil, vinegar, mustard and salt.
Arrange the asparagus, scatter with egg, capers and chives and dress.

recipes.title: Quinoa Kale Salad with Lemon
steps: Rinse the quinoa and simmer in 400 ml salted water for 15 minutes; cool.
Massage the kale with 1 tbsp oil and salt.
Toss everything with the rest of the oil and the lemon juice and zest.

recipes.title: Chopped Antipasto Salad
steps: Whisk the oil, vinegar and oregano.
Chop everything into small even pieces.
Toss with the dressing just before serving.

recipes.title: Smoked Mackerel and Potato Salad
steps: Boil the potatoes 15 minutes, drain and halve.
Mix the sour cream, horseradish and lemon.
Toss the warm potatoes with the dressing, then fold in the mackerel, radishes and dill.

recipes.title: Shrimp Po' Boy
steps: Soak the shrimp in the buttermilk for 10 minutes.
Mix the cornmeal, flour and seasoning and toss the shrimp in it.
Shallow-fry in hot oil for 2 minutes until golden and drain.
Spread the rolls with remoulade and fill with lettuce, tomato and shrimp.

recipes.title: Chicken Gyros with Tzatziki
steps: Marinate the chicken in the oil, lemon, garlic, oregano, paprika and salt for 30 minutes.
Cook in a hot frying pan for 5 to 6 minutes per side and slice.
Warm the pitas and fill with chicken, tomato, onion and tzatziki.

recipes.title: Muffuletta Sandwich

ingredients.name: Olives, chopped with pickled vegetables as olive salad

steps: Split the loaf and pull out a little of the soft crumb.
Spread both halves with the olive salad and its oil.
Layer the meats and cheese, close, wrap tightly and press under a weight for 1 hour before cutting into wedges.

recipes.title: Torta de Milanesa
steps: Dip the cutlets in beaten egg and breadcrumbs and fry in the oil for 2 minutes per side.
Split and toast the rolls and spread with the beans.
Fill with the milanesa, avocado, tomato, jalapenos and cheese.

recipes.title: Cheese and Black Bean Arepas
steps: Mix the masarepa, water and salt to a soft dough and rest 5 minutes.
Shape 8 discs 1.5 cm thick and cook in an oiled frying pan over medium heat for 5 to 6 minutes per side.
Split each pocket and fill with warm beans, cheese and avocado.

recipes.title: Pupusas de Queso

ingredients.name: Cabbage, shredded and quickly pickled as curtido

steps: Knead the masa, water and salt to a smooth dough.
Shape 8 balls, press a hollow, fill with cheese, seal and flatten to 1 cm discs.
Cook on a lightly oiled griddle over medium heat for 4 minutes per side.
Serve with curtido and salsa.

recipes.title: Pork Katsu Sando
steps: Pound the cutlets thin, dust with flour, dip in egg and coat in panko.
Fry in the oil for 3 to 4 minutes per side until cooked through.
Spread the bread with mayonnaise, add cabbage, the katsu and sauce, close and trim the crusts.

recipes.title: Monte Cristo Sandwich
steps: Make two sandwiches with the ham, turkey and cheese.
Dip them in the egg beaten with the milk.
Fry in the butter over medium heat for 3 minutes per side until golden and the cheese melts.
Dust with powdered sugar and serve with jam.

recipes.title: Goat Cheese and Fig Tartine
steps: Toast the bread.
Spread with goat cheese.
Top with figs, walnuts and thyme and drizzle with honey.

recipes.title: Smashed Burger Sliders
steps: Roll the beef into 8 balls.
Heat a heavy frying pan very hot, add a ball with a little onion and smash flat with a spatula; season.
Cook 2 minutes, flip, add cheese and cook 1 minute.
Serve on toasted buns with sauce and pickles.

recipes.title: Hummus Veggie Wrap
steps: Spread the tortillas with hummus.
Layer the vegetables and feta in a line down the middle.
Roll tightly, folding in the ends, and cut in half.

recipes.title: Curried Chickpea Salad Sandwich
steps: Mash the chickpeas roughly with a fork.
Mix in the mayonnaise, curry powder, celery, raisins, lemon and salt.
Spread on the bread with lettuce and close.

recipes.title: Philly-Style Mushroom Cheesesteak
steps: Cook the onion and pepper in the oil over medium-high heat for 6 minutes.
Add the mushrooms, worcestershire and salt and cook until browned.
Pile into two portions, lay the cheese on top to melt and scoop into the toasted rolls; use a vegetarian worcestershire if you need it meat-free.

recipes.title: Southern Hush Puppies
steps: Whisk the dry ingredients, then stir in the egg, buttermilk and onion.
Drop tablespoons into oil at 175 °C (350 °F) and fry 3 minutes, turning, until deep golden.
Drain and serve hot.

recipes.title: Classic Shrimp Cocktail
steps: Poach the shrimp in simmering salted water with lemon slices for 2 to 3 minutes until pink, then chill in iced water and peel.
Mix the ketchup, horseradish, worcestershire, hot sauce and a squeeze of lemon.
Serve the shrimp cold with the sauce.

recipes.title: Baked Mozzarella Sticks
steps: Freeze the cheese for 30 minutes.
Coat in flour, egg and the seasoned panko, then egg and panko again.
Drizzle with oil and bake at 220 °C (425 °F) for 8 to 10 minutes, just until golden before the cheese leaks.
Serve with warm marinara.

recipes.title: Labneh with Za'atar and Olive Oil
steps: Stir the salt into the yogurt and hang in a cheesecloth-lined sieve in the fridge for 12 to 24 hours.
Spread the thick labneh on a plate.
Drizzle with oil, sprinkle with za'atar and serve with warm pita.

recipes.title: Holiday Cheese Ball
steps: Beat the cream cheese, cheddar, worcestershire and green onions.
Shape into a ball, wrap and chill 1 hour.
Roll in the pecans and parsley and serve with crackers.

recipes.title: Pimento Cheese Spread
steps: Beat the cream cheese and mayonnaise until smooth.
Stir in the cheddar, pimentos and cayenne.
Chill and serve with crackers, celery or in sandwiches.

recipes.title: Swiss Cheese Fondue
steps: Rub the pot with the garlic, add the wine and lemon and bring to a simmer.
Toss the cheeses with the cornstarch and add a handful at a time, stirring in a figure-eight until smooth.
Add nutmeg and serve over a low burner with bread for dipping.

recipes.title: Dill Gravlax

ingredients.name: Salmon fillet, skin on, very fresh

steps: Mix the salt, sugar and pepper and rub over the flesh; cover with dill.
Wrap tightly and chill 48 hours under a weight, turning every 12 hours.
Scrape off, slice thinly and serve with mustard mixed with honey and a little dill; use fish suitable for eating raw, ideally previously frozen.

recipes.title: Beef Carpaccio with Arugula
steps: Freeze the beef 30 minutes, then slice paper-thin and press between parchment.
Arrange on cold plates.
Top with arugula, parmesan and capers, drizzle with oil and lemon and season; the beef is served raw, so buy from a trusted butcher.

recipes.title: Masala Vada (Lentil Fritters)
steps: Drain the dal and grind coarsely with little or no water.
Mix in the onion, chili, ginger, curry leaves, fennel and salt.
Shape small flat patties and fry at 175 °C for 4 to 5 minutes until crisp.

recipes.title: Pav Bhaji
steps: Boil the cauliflower and peas until soft.
Cook the onion and pepper in half the butter for 6 minutes, add the tomatoes and masala and cook to a paste.
Add the vegetables and potatoes and mash together with a little water to a thick curry.
Toast the rolls in the rest of the butter and serve with lemon and cilantro.

recipes.title: Khaman Dhokla

ingredients.name: Baking soda, or 1 tsp fruit salt

steps: Whisk the flour, semolina, ginger, sugar, lemon, salt and water to a smooth batter.
Stir in the fruit salt and pour at once into an oiled tin.
Steam 12 to 15 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.
Fry the mustard seeds and curry leaves in the oil with 3 tbsp water and spoon over; cut into squares.

recipes.title: Pork and Shrimp Siu Mai
steps: Mix the pork, shrimp, mushrooms, soy, sesame oil, cornstarch and ginger.
Put a spoonful on each wrapper and gather the sides up round the filling, leaving the top open.
Dot with carrot and steam on parchment for 8 to 10 minutes until cooked through.

recipes.title: Filipino Lumpia
steps: Mix the pork, carrot, onion, garlic and soy sauce.
Roll a thin log of filling in each wrapper, tucking in the sides, and seal with water.
Fry at 175 °C (350 °F) for 5 to 6 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Serve with sweet chili sauce.

recipes.title: Crab Rangoon
steps: Mix the cream cheese, crab, green onions and worcestershire.
Put a teaspoon in each wrapper, wet the edges and pinch into a star.
Fry at 175 °C for 2 to 3 minutes until golden; drain and serve with sauce.

recipes.title: Korean Scallion Seafood Pancake (Haemul Pajeon)
steps: Whisk the flours, egg, water and a pinch of salt to a thin batter.
Heat the oil in a frying pan, lay in the green onions and seafood and pour over the batter.
Cook 4 minutes over medium-high heat until crisp, flip and cook 3 to 4 minutes.
Mix the soy, vinegar and gochugaru for dipping.

recipes.title: Tteokbokki (Spicy Rice Cakes)
steps: Soak hard rice cakes in warm water for 10 minutes.
Simmer the water with the gochujang, gochugaru, sugar and soy.
Add the rice cakes and fish cakes and simmer 8 to 10 minutes, stirring, until the sauce is thick and glossy.
Add the green onions and eggs.

recipes.title: Vegetable Kimbap

ingredients.name: Eggs, made into a thin omelette and sliced

steps: Season the warm rice with sesame oil, salt and seeds.
Spread a thin layer over each nori sheet, leaving a strip at the top.
Line up the fillings, roll tightly with a bamboo mat and seal.
Brush with sesame oil and slice with a wet knife.

recipes.title: Japanese Chicken Karaage
steps: Marinate the chicken in the soy, sake, ginger and garlic for 30 minutes.
Coat in the potato starch.
Fry at 170 °C for 3 minutes, rest 3 minutes, then fry again at 190 °C for 1 minute until crisp.
Serve with lemon and mayonnaise.

recipes.title: Vegetable Tempura
steps: Whisk the yolk and ice-cold water, then stir in the flour and cornstarch with chopsticks, leaving lumps.
Dip the vegetables and fry a few at a time at 175 °C for 2 to 3 minutes until crisp and pale.
Drain and serve at once with the dipping sauce.

recipes.title: Agedashi Tofu
steps: Press the tofu 15 minutes and cut into 8 cubes.
Simmer the dashi, soy and mirin.
Coat the tofu in starch and fry at 175 °C for 3 minutes until crisp.
Set in bowls, pour round the hot broth and top with daikon and green onion.

recipes.title: Chicken Taquitos
steps: Mix the chicken, cream cheese, cheddar, salsa and cumin.
Warm the tortillas so they bend, roll a line of filling in each and lay seam-down on a tray.
Brush with oil and bake at 220 °C (425 °F) for 12 to 15 minutes until crisp.
Serve with guacamole.

recipes.title: Brazilian Cheese Bread (Pao de Queijo)
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C (400 °F).
Bring the milk, oil and salt to a boil and pour over the tapioca flour; stir until smooth and cool 10 minutes.
Beat in the eggs, then the cheese.
Scoop 20 balls onto a tray and bake 20 to 25 minutes until puffed and golden; gluten-free.

recipes.title: Turkish Cheese Borek Rolls (Sigara Boregi)
steps: Mix the feta, parsley and egg.
Cut the phyllo into triangles, put a line of filling at the wide end and roll into thin cigars, sealing with water.
Fry at 175 °C for 2 to 3 minutes until golden.

recipes.title: Stuffed Grape Leaves (Dolmades)
steps: Soften the onion in half the oil, stir in the rice, herbs and salt and cool.
Put a spoonful on each leaf, fold in the sides and roll tightly.
Pack seam-down in a pan, add the rest of the oil, the juice of 1 lemon and the water, and weigh down with a plate.
Simmer covered for 45 to 50 minutes until the rice is tender; cool and serve with lemon.

recipes.title: Scotch Eggs
steps: Boil 4 eggs for 6 minutes, chill in iced water and peel.
Divide the sausage meat with the parsley into 4, flatten and wrap round each egg.
Roll in flour, the beaten last egg and the panko.
Fry at 160 °C for 7 to 8 minutes until golden and the meat is cooked through.

recipes.title: Welsh Rarebit
steps: Melt the butter, stir in the flour, then the beer and cook to a thick sauce.
Off the heat stir in the cheese, mustard and worcestershire.
Toast the bread, spread thickly with the mixture and grill until bubbling and spotted brown.

recipes.title: Spanish Patatas Bravas
steps: Roast the potatoes with 3 tbsp oil and salt at 220 °C (425 °F) for 35 minutes, turning, until crisp.
Cook the garlic in the rest of the oil, add the paprika, cayenne and tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes; blend smooth.
Serve the potatoes with the bravas sauce and aioli.

recipes.title: Fried Calamari with Lemon
steps: Pat the squid dry.
Toss in the flour, semolina, paprika and salt.
Fry in small batches at 185 °C for 1 to 2 minutes until just golden; overcooking makes it tough.
Salt and serve with lemon and marinara.

recipes.title: Okonomiyaki
steps: Mix the flour and dashi, then the eggs, cabbage and green onions.
Pour half into an oiled frying pan as a thick pancake and lay bacon on top.
Cook 5 minutes over medium heat, flip and cook 5 minutes more.
Top with sauce, mayonnaise and bonito; repeat.

recipes.title: Potato Latkes
steps: Squeeze the potato and onion very dry in a cloth.
Mix with the eggs, flour and salt.
Fry spoonfuls flattened in hot oil for 3 to 4 minutes per side until deep golden; drain.
Serve with sour cream and applesauce.

recipes.title: Olive Tapenade
steps: Pulse everything except the oil in a food processor to a rough paste.
Stir in the oil.
Serve on toasts or with vegetables; leave out the anchovies for a vegetarian version.

recipes.title: Crispy Gyoza
steps: Squeeze the cabbage dry and mix with the pork, green onions, ginger, soy and sesame oil.
Fill and pleat the wrappers.
Fry flat-side down in the oil for 2 minutes, add 80 ml water, cover and steam 5 minutes, then uncover and crisp 1 minute.
Serve with vinegar mixed with soy.

recipes.title: Baked Vegetable Samosas
steps: Fry the cumin seeds in 1 tbsp oil, add the onion, ginger and chili for 5 minutes, then the potatoes, peas, garam masala and salt; cool.
Cut the phyllo into strips, brush with oil, put a spoonful at one end and fold into triangles.
Brush with oil and bake at 200 °C (400 °F) for 20 to 25 minutes.
Serve with tamarind chutney.

recipes.title: Onion Bhaji
steps: Mix the onions, flours, spices, chili, cilantro and salt.
Add just enough water to make the onions sticky.
Fry loose spoonfuls at 170 °C for 4 to 5 minutes until crisp and golden.

recipes.title: Mushroom Arancini

ingredients.name: Arborio rice, cooked as risotto and chilled

steps: Shape the risotto into 12 balls, pushing a cube of mozzarella into each.
Roll in flour, egg and breadcrumbs.
Fry at 175 °C for 4 to 5 minutes until golden and hot inside.
Serve with warm marinara.

recipes.title: Spanish Ham Croquetas
steps: Melt the butter, stir in the flour, then whisk in the milk and cook 8 minutes to a very thick bechamel.
Stir in the ham and nutmeg, spread on a plate, cover and chill 4 hours.
Shape into small logs, dip in egg and breadcrumbs.
Fry at 180 °C for 2 to 3 minutes until golden.

recipes.title: Durban Bunny Chow
steps: Brown the lamb in the oil and set aside; soften the onions 8 minutes, then add the garlic, ginger, curry leaves and spices.
Add the tomatoes, lamb and 400 ml water and simmer covered for 50 minutes, adding the potatoes after 25.
Cut the loaf into quarters, hollow them out and fill with the curry, using the bread you removed as a lid.

recipes.title: Senegalese Peanut Stew (Mafe)
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil and set aside; soften the onion and garlic and stir in the tomato paste.
Whisk the peanut butter into the stock, add to the pot with the chicken, vegetables and whole pepper.
Simmer 40 minutes until tender and thick; remove the pepper and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Palestinian Maqluba
steps: Simmer the chicken in the stock with the spices for 25 minutes, then lift it out and keep the stock.
Roast or fry the eggplant, cauliflower and potatoes in the oil until golden.
Layer chicken, vegetables and drained rice in a heavy pot, pour over 750 ml of stock, cover and cook on low for 35 minutes.
Rest 10 minutes, then flip onto a large platter and scatter with pine nuts.

recipes.title: Persian Fesenjan
steps: Toast the ground walnuts in a dry pan until fragrant.
Brown the chicken and onion in the oil, add the turmeric and cinnamon.
Add the walnuts and water and simmer 30 minutes, then the molasses and sugar and simmer 40 minutes more until dark and thick.
Scatter with pomegranate seeds and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Persian Herb Frittata (Kuku Sabzi)
steps: Chop the herbs and green onions very finely.
Beat the eggs with the baking powder, turmeric and salt and fold in the herbs, walnuts and berries.
Pour into a hot oiled ovenproof frying pan, cook 5 minutes over low heat and finish at 180 °C (350 °F) for 20 to 25 minutes until set.

recipes.title: Uzbek Plov
steps: Brown the lamb in the hot oil in a heavy pot, add the onions until golden, then the carrots for 10 minutes.
Add the spices, salt and water to just cover and simmer 40 minutes.
Spread the rice on top without stirring, push in the garlic head and raisins and add water to cover by 1 cm.
Cook until the water is absorbed, then cover tightly and steam on low for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Georgian Khachapuri
steps: Knead the flour, yeast, sugar, milk, oil and salt to a soft dough and rise 1 hour.
Mix the cheeses with 1 egg.
Shape 4 boats, fill with the cheese and bake at 230 °C (450 °F) for 12 minutes.
Crack an egg into each, bake 4 to 5 minutes more and add a knob of butter before serving.

recipes.title: Birria Tacos
steps: Toast and soak the chilies, then blend with the onion, garlic, tomatoes, spices and vinegar.
Cover the beef with the sauce and 1 l water and simmer covered for 3 hours until it shreds.
Shred the meat and skim the red fat from the broth.
Dip tortillas in the fat, fry with cheese and meat, fold, and serve with cups of broth, cilantro and lime.

recipes.title: Enfrijoladas
steps: Blend the beans with their liquid, the chipotle, garlic and stock until smooth and warm in a wide pan.
Soften the tortillas in the hot oil.
Dip each tortilla in the sauce, fold into quarters and arrange on plates.
Spoon over more sauce and top with cheese, cream and onion.

recipes.title: Filipino Pork Sinigang
steps: Simmer the pork with the onion and tomatoes in the water for 45 minutes, skimming.
Add the tamarind and daikon and cook 10 minutes.
Add the beans for 4 minutes and the greens for 1 minute; season with fish sauce and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Japanese Beef Curry (Kare Raisu)
steps: Brown the beef in the oil, add the onions and cook 10 minutes until golden.
Add the carrots, potatoes, apple and water and simmer 30 minutes.
Turn off the heat, stir in the roux until dissolved and simmer 5 minutes more until thick.
Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Katsudon
steps: Coat the cutlets in flour, egg and panko and fry 3 to 4 minutes per side; slice.
Simmer the onion in the dashi, soy, mirin and sugar for 4 minutes in a small pan.
Lay in the katsu, pour the 3 beaten eggs round it, cover and cook 1 minute until just set.
Slide over bowls of rice.

recipes.title: Gyudon (Beef and Onion Rice Bowl)
steps: Simmer the onion in the dashi, soy, mirin, sake and sugar for 5 minutes.
Add the beef and cook 2 minutes, skimming.
Spoon over the rice with the sauce and top with pickled ginger.

recipes.title: Korean Spicy Chicken Stir-Fry (Dakgalbi)
steps: Marinate the chicken in the gochujang, gochugaru, soy, sugar and garlic for 30 minutes.
Stir-fry the sweet potato and onion in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the chicken, cabbage and rice cakes and cook 12 to 15 minutes, stirring, until the chicken is cooked through.

recipes.title: Hokkien Char Kway Teow

ingredients.name: Soy sauce, 2 of them dark soy

steps: Mix the soy sauce, sugar and sambal.
Stir-fry the shrimp and sausage in a smoking wok for 2 minutes.
Add the noodles and sauce and toss 2 minutes, push aside and scramble the eggs into the noodles.
Add the bean sprouts and chives and toss 30 seconds.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Turmeric Fish with Dill (Cha Ca)
steps: Marinate the fish in the turmeric, fish sauce, sugar and ginger for 20 minutes.
Pan-fry in the oil over high heat for 2 to 3 minutes per side until golden.
Add the dill and green onions and toss just until wilted.
Serve over noodles with peanuts and nuoc cham.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Broken Rice with Pork (Com Tam)

ingredients.name: Jasmine rice, cooked, or broken rice

steps: Marinate the chops in the fish sauce, sugar, garlic, lemongrass and oil for at least 1 hour.
Grill or pan-fry 3 to 4 minutes per side until caramelised.
Serve over rice with a fried egg, cucumber, tomato and nuoc cham.

recipes.title: Northern Thai Curry Noodles (Khao Soi)
steps: Fry the curry paste and curry powder in the oil with a little coconut milk until fragrant.
Add the chicken, the rest of the coconut milk and the stock and simmer 20 minutes; season with fish sauce and sugar.
Fry a handful of the noodles until crisp and boil the rest.
Serve the noodles in the curry topped with crispy noodles, onion, cilantro and lime.

recipes.title: Thai Chicken with Chili Paste (Pad Prik Gaeng)
steps: Fry the curry paste in the oil for 1 minute.
Add the chicken and stir-fry 4 to 5 minutes.
Add the beans, fish sauce, sugar and a splash of water and cook 3 minutes.
Toss in the lime leaves and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Chole (Punjabi Chickpea Curry)
steps: Fry the cumin seeds in the oil, add the onions and cook 10 minutes until brown.
Add the paste, then the tomatoes and spices and cook until the oil separates.
Add the chickpeas and 300 ml water and simmer 20 minutes, mashing a few chickpeas to thicken.
Finish with cilantro and serve with rice or bhatura.

recipes.title: Malai Kofta
steps: Mix the potato, paneer, cornstarch, chopped cashews and salt and roll into 12 balls.
Fry at 170 °C until golden and drain.
Cook the onions, tomatoes and paste in 2 tbsp oil for 10 minutes, blend with the soaked cashews and return to the pan with the spices and 200 ml water.
Simmer 10 minutes, stir in the cream and add the kofta just before serving.

recipes.title: Kadai Paneer
steps: Toast and coarsely grind the coriander and chilies.
Stir-fry the peppers and onion in the oil for 3 minutes and set aside.
Cook the paste and tomatoes with the ground spices until thick, add the paneer, vegetables, garam masala and methi and toss for 3 minutes.

recipes.title: Greek Beef Stifado
steps: Brown the beef in the oil and set aside; brown the onions.
Add the garlic and tomato paste, then the wine and vinegar and bubble 2 minutes.
Return the beef with the tomatoes, spices and enough water to cover and simmer covered for 1 1/2 to 2 hours until very tender.

recipes.title: Greek Stuffed Tomatoes and Peppers (Gemista)
steps: Cut lids off the vegetables, scoop out the tomato flesh and chop it.
Cook the onion and zucchini in half the oil, add the rice, tomato flesh, herbs and salt and simmer 5 minutes.
Fill the vegetables loosely, put on the lids and tuck the potatoes between them.
Drizzle with the rest of the oil and 200 ml water and bake at 190 °C (375 °F) for 60 to 70 minutes.

recipes.title: Lamb Kleftiko

ingredients.name: Leg of lamb, bone-in, or shoulder

steps: Rub the lamb with crushed garlic, lemon, oregano, oil and salt and marinate at least 2 hours.
Put the potatoes and onion in a large sheet of parchment and foil, sit the lamb on top with the feta and seal tightly.
Bake at 160 °C (325 °F) for 4 hours until falling apart, then open and brown at 200 °C for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Milanese Ossobuco
steps: Dust the shanks in flour and brown in the oil; set aside.
Soften the vegetables, add the wine and reduce, then the tomatoes and stock.
Return the shanks, cover and simmer 1 1/2 to 2 hours until tender.
Chop the lemon zest, garlic and parsley together for gremolata and scatter over to serve.

recipes.title: Italian Meatballs (Polpette) in Broth
steps: Mix the beef, egg, parmesan, breadcrumbs, parsley and salt and roll into small balls.
Bring the stock to a simmer, drop in the meatballs and cook 10 minutes.
Add the pasta and cook until tender, then stir in the spinach.

recipes.title: Spanish Seafood Fideua

ingredients.name: Fideo noodles, or broken thin spaghetti

steps: Toast the noodles in half the oil until golden and set aside.
Cook the onion, garlic and paprika in the rest of the oil, add the tomatoes, then the squid.
Add the hot stock, saffron and noodles, spread evenly and simmer 10 minutes.
Push in the shrimp and cook 5 minutes until the liquid is absorbed; serve with lemon and aioli.

recipes.title: Spanish Pisto with Fried Eggs
steps: Cook the onion and peppers in the oil for 10 minutes.
Add the eggplant and zucchini and cook 10 minutes more.
Add the garlic and tomatoes and simmer 15 minutes until thick.
Fry the eggs and serve on top.

recipes.title: Asturian Bean Stew (Fabada)
steps: Cover the beans and meats with cold water, add the onion and garlic and bring slowly to a simmer, skimming.
Add the saffron and paprika and simmer very gently for 2 to 2 1/2 hours, adding cold water occasionally so the beans stay covered.
Slice the meats and serve with the beans.

recipes.title: Portuguese Salt Cod with Potatoes (Bacalhau a Bras)
steps: Poach the cod 5 minutes, then flake, removing skin and bones.
Fry the potato sticks in half the oil until crisp and set aside.
Soften the onions and garlic in the rest, add the cod and potatoes.
Pour in the beaten eggs and stir gently until just creamy; finish with olives and parsley.

recipes.title: Polish Hunter's Stew (Bigos)
steps: Fry the bacon, then brown the pork and onion.
Add the sauerkraut, cabbage, mushrooms and their water, tomato paste, wine, spices and prunes.
Simmer covered for 1 1/2 hours, add the kielbasa and cook 30 minutes more; it tastes better the next day.

recipes.title: Polish Cabbage Rolls (Golabki)
steps: Core the cabbage and blanch whole, peeling off 12 leaves as they soften.
Mix the meat, rice, onion, egg, paprika and salt.
Roll a portion in each leaf, folding in the sides, and pack seam-down in a dish.
Pour over the tomato sauce, cover and bake at 175 °C (350 °F) for 1 1/2 hours.

recipes.title: Siberian Pelmeni
steps: Knead the flour, egg, water and salt to a firm dough and rest 30 minutes.
Mix the meats, onion, pepper and salt.
Roll the dough thin, cut 5 cm rounds, fill, fold and pinch the corners together.
Boil in salted water for 6 to 8 minutes after they float; toss with butter and serve with sour cream and dill.

recipes.title: German Cheese Spaetzle (Kasespatzle)
steps: Beat the flour, eggs, milk, nutmeg and salt to a thick sticky batter and rest 10 minutes.
Press through a colander into simmering salted water in batches and lift out when they float.
Fry the onions in the butter until deep golden.
Layer the spaetzle and cheese in a dish, top with the onions and bake at 200 °C (400 °F) for 10 minutes; scatter with chives.

recipes.title: German Beef Rouladen

ingredients.name: Thin beef slices, from the round

steps: Spread the beef with mustard, lay on bacon, onion and pickle and roll up, securing with toothpicks.
Brown in the oil, add the stock and wine, cover and simmer 1 1/2 hours until tender.
Lift out the rolls, thicken the sauce with the cornstarch mixed with water and season.

recipes.title: Alsatian Flammkuchen
steps: Knead the flour, water, oil and salt to a smooth dough and rest 20 minutes.
Heat the oven as hot as it goes with a tray inside.
Roll the dough paper-thin, spread with creme fraiche seasoned with salt and nutmeg, and scatter with onion and lardons.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes until crisp and blistered.

recipes.title: Cornish Pasties
steps: Rub the butter into the flour and salt, add the water and bring together; chill 30 minutes.
Mix the beef and vegetables with plenty of salt and pepper.
Roll 4 rounds, pile filling on one half, fold over and crimp the edge.
Brush with egg and bake at 200 °C (400 °F) for 20 minutes, then at 170 °C (340 °F) for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Louisiana Chicken and Sausage Gumbo
steps: Cook the oil and flour over medium-low heat, stirring constantly, for 25 to 30 minutes to a dark brown roux.
Add the onion, pepper and celery and cook 8 minutes, then the garlic.
Whisk in the stock, add the chicken, sausage, seasoning and bay and simmer 1 hour.
Shred the chicken, skim the fat and serve over rice with green onions.

recipes.title: Crawfish Etouffee
steps: Cook the butter and flour, stirring, for 8 to 10 minutes to a peanut-coloured roux.
Add the vegetables and cook 8 minutes, then the garlic and seasoning.
Stir in the stock and simmer 15 minutes.
Add the crawfish and cook 5 minutes; serve over rice with green onions.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Fried Chicken
steps: Soak the chicken in the buttermilk, hot sauce and 1 tsp salt overnight.
Mix the flour, spices and remaining salt and dredge the chicken well, pressing on.
Fry at 160 °C (325 °F) for 12 to 15 minutes, turning, until golden and the inside reads 74 °C (165 °F).
Drain on a rack.

recipes.title: Chili Mac
steps: Brown the beef and onion in a large pot.
Add the chili powder, beans, tomatoes and stock and bring to a boil.
Stir in the macaroni, cover and simmer 12 minutes, stirring, until tender.
Top with the cheese and cover until melted.

recipes.title: Brunswick Stew
steps: Simmer everything except the corn and beans in a large pot for 40 minutes.
Shred the chicken in the pot.
Add the corn and beans and simmer 20 minutes more until thick.

recipes.title: Jamaican Braised Oxtail
steps: Season the oxtail with soy, browning, garlic, ginger, allspice and salt and marinate overnight.
Brown well in the oil, add the onion, green onions, thyme, pepper and water to cover.
Simmer covered for 2 1/2 to 3 hours until falling from the bone, adding the beans for the last 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Trinidad Chicken Pelau
steps: Heat the oil and sugar in a heavy pot until it caramelises dark amber, then add the chicken and stir to coat.
Add the onion, then the rice, peas, carrots, coconut milk, water, pepper and salt.
Cover and cook on low for 30 to 35 minutes until the rice is tender; remove the pepper and add the cilantro.

recipes.title: Puerto Rican Mofongo
steps: Fry the plantain chunks at 175 °C for 8 to 10 minutes until tender and golden.
Mash the garlic and salt with the olive oil in a mortar.
Pound the plantains with the garlic oil and chicharrones in batches, adding a little stock, and shape into domes.
Serve with more hot stock spooned over.

recipes.title: Puerto Rican Roast Pork (Pernil)
steps: Pound the garlic, oregano, salt and pepper with the oil, vinegar and sazon.
Cut deep slits all over the meat and rub in the paste; marinate overnight.
Roast covered at 160 °C (325 °F) for 4 hours, then uncover and roast at 220 °C (425 °F) for 30 to 45 minutes until the skin crackles.

recipes.title: Haitian Griot (Fried Pork)
steps: Blend the orange and lime juice, onion, garlic, pepper, thyme and salt and marinate the pork overnight.
Simmer the pork in the marinade with water to cover for 1 hour until tender and the liquid has reduced.
Drain and fry in hot oil for 4 to 5 minutes until crisp and browned.

recipes.title: Indonesian Mee Goreng
steps: Cook the noodles and drain.
Stir-fry the garlic and shallots in the oil, add the chicken and shrimp and cook 3 minutes.
Push aside, scramble the eggs, then add the cabbage, noodles, kecap manis, soy and sambal and toss over high heat for 2 minutes.
Scatter with fried shallots.

recipes.title: Korean Braised Pork Belly Wraps (Bossam)
steps: Simmer the pork in water with the onion, garlic, ginger, doenjang and coffee for 60 to 70 minutes until tender.
Rest 10 minutes and slice thinly.
Serve with cabbage leaves for wrapping, kimchi and ssamjang.

recipes.title: Kenyan Beef Stew with Sukuma Wiki
steps: Brown the beef in 2 tbsp oil, add half the onions, the garlic, tomatoes, curry powder and water to cover and simmer 1 hour.
Add the carrots and cook 15 minutes.
Fry the rest of the onion in the remaining oil, add the greens and a splash of water and cook 5 minutes.
Serve the stew with the greens and ugali or rice.

recipes.title: Roman Egg Drop Soup (Stracciatella)
steps: Bring the stock to a simmer and add the spinach.
Beat the eggs, parmesan, semolina and nutmeg.
Pour into the simmering stock while stirring gently so it forms soft strands; cook 1 minute and add parsley.

recipes.title: Scotch Broth
steps: Simmer the lamb, barley and peas in the water for 1 hour, skimming.
Add the vegetables and simmer 40 minutes more.
Lift out the lamb, shred the meat back in and season; scatter with parsley.

recipes.title: Colombian Chicken and Potato Soup (Ajiaco)

ingredients.name: Potatoes, half floury and sliced, half waxy and cubed

steps: Simmer the chicken in the stock with the cilantro stems for 30 minutes, then shred it.
Add the potatoes and corn and simmer 30 minutes so some potatoes break down to thicken.
Return the chicken.
Serve with cream, capers and avocado.

recipes.title: Ecuadorian Potato Cheese Soup (Locro de Papa)
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in the butter with the cumin and achiote.
Add the potatoes and stock and simmer 20 minutes, mashing some to thicken.
Stir in the milk and most of the cheese and heat gently.
Top with avocado, cilantro and more cheese.

recipes.title: Peruvian Chicken Cilantro Soup (Aguadito de Pollo)
steps: Blend the cilantro with a little stock.
Brown the chicken in the oil, add the onion, garlic and aji and cook 5 minutes.
Add the stock, rice and potatoes and simmer 25 minutes.
Add the cilantro puree, pepper and peas and cook 5 minutes; serve with lime.

recipes.title: Greek White Bean Soup (Fasolada)
steps: Simmer the drained beans in fresh water for 30 minutes and drain.
Soften the vegetables in half the oil, add the tomato paste and tomatoes.
Add the beans, bay, oregano and water to cover by 3 cm and simmer 1 hour until creamy.
Stir in the rest of the oil and season; serve with lemon.

recipes.title: Korean Soybean Paste Stew (Doenjang Jjigae)
steps: Bring the stock to a boil and whisk in the doenjang and gochujang.
Add the potato and onion and simmer 8 minutes.
Add the zucchini, mushrooms, garlic and tofu and simmer 6 minutes.
Add the chili and green onion and serve bubbling with rice.

recipes.title: South Indian Tomato Rasam
steps: Simmer the tomatoes, tamarind, pepper, cumin, garlic, turmeric, rasam powder, salt and water for 15 minutes.
Fry the mustard seeds and curry leaves in the ghee until they pop and pour into the rasam.
Add cilantro; serve as a thin soup or over rice.

recipes.title: Caribbean Callaloo
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in the butter.
Add the greens, okra, coconut milk, stock, thyme and whole pepper and simmer 25 minutes.
Remove the pepper and swizzle or blend until smooth.

recipes.title: Korean Rice Cake Soup (Tteokguk)
steps: Soak the rice cakes in water for 20 minutes.
Brown the beef in the sesame oil with the garlic, add the stock and soy sauce and simmer 15 minutes.
Add the rice cakes and cook 5 minutes until soft and floating.
Drizzle in the eggs, then top with green onions and nori.

recipes.title: Spanish Garlic Soup (Sopa de Ajo)
steps: Fry the garlic gently in the oil until golden, add the bread and toast it in the oil.
Stir in the paprika and pour in the stock; simmer 10 minutes.
Crack in the eggs and poach 3 to 4 minutes.
Scatter with ham.

recipes.title: Andalusian Salmorejo
steps: Blend the tomatoes, bread, garlic, vinegar and salt until very smooth.
Blend in the oil slowly to a thick, creamy soup and chill 2 hours.
Serve topped with chopped egg, ham and a drizzle of oil.

recipes.title: Creamy Carrot Soup with Cumin
steps: Soften the onion in the oil with the cumin.
Add the carrots and stock and simmer 25 minutes until very soft.
Blend with the coconut milk and orange zest and season.

recipes.title: Matzo Ball Soup
steps: Mix the matzo meal, eggs, fat, 3 tbsp stock and salt and chill 30 minutes.
Roll into 12 balls with wet hands and simmer in salted water, covered, for 30 to 40 minutes.
Simmer the carrots and celery in the stock for 15 minutes, add the chicken and matzo balls and finish with dill.

recipes.title: Fish Soup with Saffron and Fennel
steps: Soften the fennel, onion and garlic in the oil for 8 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, saffron, orange peel and stock and simmer 15 minutes.
Add the fish and shrimp and poach gently 5 minutes.
Scatter with parsley and serve with crusty bread.

recipes.title: Indonesian Chicken Soup (Soto Ayam)
steps: Blend the shallots, garlic, ginger, turmeric and nuts to a paste and fry in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the chicken, lemongrass, lime leaves, water and salt and simmer 40 minutes.
Shred the chicken.
Serve the broth over noodles, sprouts, chicken and halved eggs with fried shallots and lime.

recipes.title: Turkish Ayran
steps: Whisk the yogurt, water and salt until frothy.
Pour over ice and add mint.

recipes.title: Arnold Palmer (Half Tea Half Lemonade)
steps: Steep the tea in the boiling water for 5 minutes, remove and cool.
Stir the lemon juice and sugar into the cold water until dissolved.
Mix the tea and lemonade and serve over ice.

recipes.title: Strawberry Basil Shrub
steps: Crush the strawberries with the sugar and basil and leave 1 day in the fridge.
Strain, pressing the fruit, and stir in the vinegar; keep chilled up to 2 weeks.
Mix about 3 tbsp of shrub with sparkling water and ice per glass.

recipes.title: Ginger Honey Switchel
steps: Stir the vinegar, honey, ginger and lemon juice into the water until the honey dissolves.
Chill 2 hours, strain and serve over ice.

recipes.title: Homemade Ginger Beer (Quick)
steps: Simmer the ginger, sugar and water for 10 minutes and steep until cool.
Strain and add the lime juice.
Mix 1 part syrup with 3 parts sparkling water over ice.

recipes.title: Jamaican Sorrel Drink
steps: Boil the water with the ginger, cinnamon, cloves and orange peel, then add the hibiscus and turn off the heat.
Steep at least 4 hours or overnight.
Strain, stir in the sugar and chill; serve over ice.

recipes.title: Mango Pineapple Smoothie
steps: Blend everything until smooth.
Add a splash more coconut water if too thick.

recipes.title: Classic Eggnog
steps: Heat the milk, cream, cinnamon and nutmeg until steaming.
Whisk the yolks and sugar, pour on the hot milk while whisking and return to the pan.
Stir over low heat until it coats a spoon, about 71 °C (160 °F), add the vanilla, strain and chill.

recipes.title: Mexican Spiced Coffee (Cafe de Olla)
steps: Simmer the water with the sugar, cinnamon, orange peel and cloves for 5 minutes.
Stir in the coffee, turn off the heat and steep 5 minutes.
Strain through a fine sieve or filter and serve hot.

recipes.title: Chai Latte
steps: Simmer the water with the spices for 5 minutes.
Add the tea and milk and heat to steaming for 3 minutes.
Strain, sweeten with honey and froth if you like.

recipes.title: Brown Sugar Bubble Tea
steps: Cook the tapioca pearls following the packet, about 15 minutes, and drain.
Simmer the brown sugar and 60 ml water to a syrup and stir in the pearls.
Brew strong tea with the boiling water and cool.
Spoon the pearls and syrup into glasses, add ice, tea and milk.

recipes.title: Cucumber Lime Lemonade
steps: Blend the cucumber with 250 ml of the water and strain.
Stir the citrus juice and sugar into the rest of the water until dissolved.
Mix with the cucumber juice and serve over ice.

recipes.title: Elderflower Spritzer
steps: Divide the cordial between two glasses with ice.
Top with sparkling water.
Add a squeeze of lime and mint.

recipes.title: Orange Cream Smoothie
steps: Blend everything until frothy.
Serve at once.

recipes.title: Butter-Basted Ribeye
steps: Pat the steaks dry and salt them on both sides 30 minutes ahead if you can.
Heat a heavy pan until very hot. Sear the steaks 3-4 minutes per side.
Add the butter, tilt the pan and spoon the foaming butter over the steaks for a minute. Rest 5 minutes before slicing.

recipes.title: Soft Scrambled Eggs in Butter
steps: Whisk the eggs with the cream and salt.
Melt the butter in a pan over low heat, add the eggs and stir slowly with a spatula until just set and creamy.
Take off the heat while still slightly glossy; they finish cooking on the plate.

recipes.title: Pan-Seared Salmon with Brown Butter
steps: Dry the salmon well and salt both sides.
Cook skin side down in a hot pan with a little of the butter for 5-6 minutes until the skin is crisp, then turn for 1-2 minutes.
Remove the fish, add the rest of the butter and cook until it smells nutty and turns golden. Pour over the salmon.

recipes.title: Simple Beef Patties
steps: Divide the beef into 4 balls and press into patties a little wider than you want them. Salt both sides.
Cook in a hot pan or on a grill 3-4 minutes per side. Add the cheese for the last minute if using.

recipes.title: Slow-Roasted Pork Belly
steps: Dry the skin well, rub the salt into the scores and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight if you have time. Brush the meat side (not the skin) with the ghee.
Roast at 150 °C for 2 hours, then turn the oven up to 230 °C for 20-30 minutes until the crackling puffs.
Rest 10 minutes, then cut into thick slices.

recipes.title: Simple Beef Bone Broth
steps: Roast the bones at 220 °C for 40 minutes until browned.
Put them in a large pot with the water, bring to a bare simmer and skim. Simmer gently, partly covered, for 6-8 hours, topping up with water.
Strain, season with salt and cool. Lift off the fat once cold. Keeps 4 days in the fridge or 3 months frozen.

recipes.title: Crispy Chicken Thighs
steps: Dry the chicken and salt the skin.
Start skin side down in a cold heavy pan, then cook over medium heat for 20-25 minutes until the fat has rendered and the skin is deep golden.
Turn, add the butter and baste; cook 8-10 minutes more, until 75 °C inside.

recipes.title: Lamb Chops with Butter
steps: Salt the chops and sear in a hot pan 3 minutes per side for pink, holding them fat edge down for a minute to crisp the fat.
Add the butter for the last minute and spoon it over.

recipes.title: Cuban Black Beans (Frijoles Negros)
steps: Soften the onion and pepper in the oil for 8 minutes, add the garlic, cumin and oregano for a minute.
Add the beans with their liquid and the bay leaf. Simmer 15-20 minutes, mashing a few beans to thicken.
Stir in the vinegar and sugar, season and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Dominican Mangú with Pickled Onions

ingredients.name: Green plantains, peeled and cut in chunks

steps: Boil the plantains in salted water for 15-20 minutes until very tender.
Meanwhile soften the onion in a little oil, add the vinegar and a pinch of salt and cook 2 minutes.
Mash the plantains with the butter and some of the cooking water until smooth. Top with the onions; serve with eggs or fried cheese.

recipes.title: Haitian Pikliz
steps: Pack the vegetables, peppers, garlic and peppercorns into a clean jar.
Mix the salt, vinegar and lime juice and pour over to cover. Close and refrigerate at least 1 day before using. Wear gloves for the peppers.

recipes.title: Trinidadian Curry Chickpeas (Channa)
steps: Fry the onion and garlic in the oil until soft, add the curry powder and cumin with a splash of water and cook 2 minutes.
Add the chickpeas, potato, water and green seasoning. Simmer 15-20 minutes until the potato is soft and the sauce thick; crush some chickpeas.
Season and serve with roti or rice.

recipes.title: Bajan Cou-Cou with Okra
steps: Simmer the okra in the water with the salt for 8 minutes.
Mix the cornmeal with a little cold water to a paste, then whisk into the pot over low heat.
Stir with a wooden spoon for 8-10 minutes until thick and pulling from the sides. Beat in the butter, shape in a buttered bowl and turn out. Serve with flying fish or any stewed fish.

recipes.title: Bahamian Conch-Style Fritters with Shrimp
steps: Fritters in the Bahamas use conch; shrimp is an easy stand-in.
Mix the flour, baking powder and salt, then the egg and milk to a thick batter. Fold in the shrimp and vegetables.
Fry spoonfuls in oil at 175 °C for 3-4 minutes until golden. Drain and serve with a lime and hot sauce dip.

recipes.title: Guyanese Pepperpot-Style Beef Stew
steps: Traditional pepperpot uses cassareep (cassava extract); molasses gives a similar dark sweetness.
Brown the beef in the oil in batches. Add the onion and garlic and cook 5 minutes.

Add the spices, pepper, sugar, cassareep or molasses, thyme and water to just cover. Simmer covered for 2-2½ hours until very tender and the sauce is dark and glossy. Remove the whole pepper. Best the next day.

recipes.title: Grenadian Oil Down

ingredients.name: Breadfruit, peeled and cut in chunks
Salt cod, soaked overnight and flaked

steps: Layer the onion, garlic, thyme, fish, breadfruit and carrot in a heavy pot. Add the turmeric to the coconut milk with 250 ml water and pour over.
Cover and simmer gently 40 minutes without stirring, until the breadfruit is tender and has soaked up most of the liquid.
Lay the callaloo on top for the last 10 minutes. Serve from the pot.

recipes.title: Reverse-Seared Thick Strip Steak

ingredients.name: Sirloin steak, strip cut about 4 cm thick

steps: Salt the steak and set it on a rack over a tray. Bake at 120 °C until the centre reaches 50 °C, about 45-50 minutes.
Heat the tallow in a heavy pan until smoking and sear the steak 60-90 seconds per side, edges too.
Rest 5 minutes, slice across the grain and season with the pepper.

recipes.title: Tallow-Fried Flank Steak Strips
steps: Slice the steak thinly across the grain and dry the strips well. Salt them.
Heat half the tallow in a wide pan until very hot. Fry half the strips in one layer for 1-2 minutes without moving, then turn for 30 seconds.
Repeat with the rest of the tallow and beef. Serve straight away.

recipes.title: Garlic-Free Butter Burger Bowls
steps: Shape the beef into 4 thick patties and salt both sides.
Cook in a hot pan 4 minutes per side. Move to bowls.
Melt the butter in the same pan and fry the eggs until the whites set. Put one on each patty with the cheese if using.

recipes.title: Slow-Braised Beef Short Ribs in Bone Broth
steps: Salt the ribs. Brown them all over in the tallow in a heavy casserole, in batches.
Return all the ribs, pour in the broth, cover and cook at 150 °C for 3-3½ hours until the meat pulls from the bone.
Spoon off the fat, reduce the liquid on the hob until glossy and pour over the ribs. Season with the pepper.

recipes.title: Oven Beef Brisket, Salt and Pepper Rub
steps: Rub the brisket all over with the salt and pepper. Leave 1 hour, or overnight in the fridge.
Set fat side up in a roasting tin, add the stock, cover tightly with foil and roast at 140 °C for 5 hours until a skewer slides in easily.
Rest 30 minutes in the foil, then slice across the grain and spoon over the juices.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Beef Chuck Roast
steps: Cut the roast into 2-3 large pieces and salt them. Brown well in the tallow on the sauté setting.
Add the broth, lock the lid and cook at high pressure for 70 minutes. Let the pressure release naturally for 15 minutes.
Shred with two forks and toss with some of the cooking liquid.

recipes.title: Beef and Bone Marrow Patties

ingredients.name: Bone marrow, scooped from roasted bones and chilled

steps: Chop the cold marrow into small pieces and mix gently into the beef with the salt.
Shape 4 patties and chill for 15 minutes.
Cook in a hot dry pan 3-4 minutes per side; the marrow bastes the burgers as they cook.

recipes.title: Roasted Marrow Bones

ingredients.name: Beef marrow bones, cut canoe-style or in short lengths

steps: Soak the bones in cold salted water for a few hours if you have time, then dry them.
Stand them marrow side up on a tray and roast at 220 °C for 15-20 minutes until the marrow is soft and just starting to pull away.
Scoop out with a small spoon and sprinkle with the salt. Finish with the black pepper.

recipes.title: Pan-Fried Beef Liver in Butter
steps: Trim any tubes from the liver and pat the slices dry.
Melt the butter in a large pan until foaming. Fry the liver 1-2 minutes per side so it stays pink in the middle.
Season with salt and pepper and spoon the butter over.

recipes.title: Chicken Liver Pâté with Butter
steps: Trim the livers. Fry them in 2 tablespoons of the butter over medium heat for 4-5 minutes until just pink inside.
Blend with the rest of the butter, the cream and salt until very smooth.
Pack into a dish, smooth the top and chill for at least 3 hours.

recipes.title: Seared Lamb Kidneys
steps: Halve the kidneys and snip out the white core. Pat dry.
Fry in the foaming butter over high heat for 2 minutes per side.
Season and serve with the pan butter.

recipes.title: Grilled Beef Heart Skewers
steps: Cut away the fat and sinew and slice the heart into 3 cm pieces. Thread onto skewers.
Brush with the tallow and salt.
Grill over very high heat for 2-3 minutes per side, keeping the centre pink.

recipes.title: Slow-Cooked Beef Tongue
steps: Cover the tongue with water, add the salt and simmer gently for 3½-4 hours until tender.
While still warm, peel off the skin and trim the root end. Slice or dice.
Crisp the pieces in the lard in a hot pan before serving.

recipes.title: Pork Belly Bites
steps: Cut the pork belly into 3 cm cubes and toss with the salt.
Spread on a tray and roast at 200 °C for 45-60 minutes, turning once, until crisp and well browned.
Drain on a rack and eat hot. Finish with the black pepper.

recipes.title: Pork Shoulder Carnitas in Lard
steps: Cut the pork into 5 cm chunks and salt well.
Melt the lard in a heavy pot, add the pork and just enough water to come halfway up. Simmer uncovered for 2½ hours, stirring now and then.
When the water has cooked off, let the pork fry in its fat until golden, then break into pieces.

recipes.title: Simple Pork Chops with Brown Butter
steps: Salt the chops and leave 20 minutes.
Sear in a hot pan with a little butter for 4-5 minutes per side to 63 °C.
Rest the chops, add the rest of the butter and cook until nutty. Pour over and finish with the pepper.

recipes.title: Crackling Pork Shoulder Roast
steps: Dry the skin and rub in the salt. Leave uncovered in the fridge overnight if possible.
Roast at 160 °C for 3½ hours, then turn up to 230 °C for 25 minutes until the skin crackles.
Rest 20 minutes before pulling or carving. Finish with the black pepper.

recipes.title: Pork Ribs, Salt and Pepper
steps: Rub the ribs with the salt and pepper.
Wrap in foil and bake at 150 °C for 2 hours.
Unwrap, turn the oven to 220 °C and roast 20-30 minutes until the outside is crusty.

recipes.title: Ground Pork and Egg Skillet
steps: Fry the pork in the lard, breaking it up, until well browned and crisp in places. Season with salt.
Make 4 hollows and crack in the eggs.
Cover and cook over low heat for 3-4 minutes until the whites are set.

recipes.title: Braised Pork Cheeks
steps: Salt the cheeks and brown them in the lard in a casserole.
Add the stock, cover and cook gently on the hob or at 150 °C for 2-2½ hours until spoon-tender.
Lift out the cheeks and boil the liquid until it coats a spoon. Pour over.

recipes.title: Herb-Free Roast Leg of Lamb
steps: Rub the lamb with the ghee, salt and pepper. Leave at room temperature for 1 hour.
Roast at 220 °C for 20 minutes, then at 180 °C for about 1 hour 10 minutes for pink meat (60 °C in the thickest part).
Rest 20 minutes covered loosely with foil, then carve.

recipes.title: Lamb Chops Seared in Their Own Fat
steps: Salt the chops. Stand them on their fatty edge in a cold heavy pan and turn on the heat; render the fat for 4-5 minutes.
Lay the chops flat and cook 3 minutes per side in the rendered fat.
Rest 3 minutes before eating. Finish with the black pepper.

recipes.title: Slow-Roast Lamb Shoulder
steps: Salt the lamb all over. Put it in a deep tin with the broth.
Cover tightly and roast at 150 °C for 4 hours until it falls apart.
Uncover for the last 20 minutes at 200 °C to brown. Pull apart and spoon over the juices.

recipes.title: Ground Lamb Kofta, Meat Only
steps: Knead the lamb with the salt and pepper for 2 minutes until sticky.
Shape into 12 long koftas, on skewers if you like. Chill 20 minutes.
Grill or pan-fry over high heat for 8-10 minutes, turning, until browned and just cooked through.

recipes.title: Lamb Neck Stew in Bone Broth
steps: Brown the lamb in a dry pot in batches, letting the fat render.
Add the broth and salt, bring to a bare simmer and cook covered for 2-2½ hours until tender.
Skim the fat and serve the meat in the broth.

recipes.title: Crispy Duck Breasts
steps: Score the skin in a close crisscross without cutting the meat. Salt well.
Put skin side down in a cold pan and cook over medium-low heat for 12-15 minutes, pouring off the fat now and then, until the skin is thin and crisp.
Turn and cook 2 minutes. Rest 5 minutes and slice. Keep the fat for other cooking. Finish with the black pepper.

recipes.title: Duck Fat Roast Chicken
steps: Dry the chicken and rub the skin with the duck fat and salt.
Roast at 200 °C for 1 hour 10-20 minutes until the juices at the thigh run clear (74 °C).
Rest 15 minutes and carve. Spoon the pan fat over.

recipes.title: Butter-Poached Chicken Breast
steps: Salt the chicken. Melt the butter with the water in a small pan over low heat.
Add the chicken, cover and poach very gently, turning once, for 15-20 minutes until it reaches 70 °C.
Rest 5 minutes and slice; spoon over the butter.

recipes.title: Schmaltz-Roasted Chicken Wings
steps: Dry the wings very well. Toss with the melted schmaltz and salt.
Spread on a rack over a tray and roast at 220 °C for 40-45 minutes, turning once, until crisp.

recipes.title: Chicken Thigh Skewers with Skin
steps: Cut the thighs into 3 cm pieces and thread onto skewers, folding the skin around the meat.
Salt all over.
Grill over high heat 10-12 minutes, turning often, until the skin is crisp and the meat is cooked through. Finish with the black pepper.

recipes.title: Chicken Heart Skewers
steps: Trim the hearts of any fat and tubes. Thread onto skewers.
Brush with the butter and season with the salt.
Grill over high heat for 6-8 minutes, turning, until browned outside.

recipes.title: Turkey Thigh Roast
steps: Loosen the skin and rub the butter underneath and over the top. Salt well.
Roast at 190 °C for 1¼-1½ hours until the meat reaches 80 °C near the bone.
Rest 10 minutes, then slice off the bone.

recipes.title: Ground Turkey Meatballs in Broth
steps: Mix the turkey, egg, parmesan and half the salt. Roll into small balls.
Bring the broth to a simmer with the remaining salt.
Drop in the meatballs and simmer for 10-12 minutes until cooked through.

recipes.title: Slow-Simmered Chicken Bone Broth

ingredients.name: Chicken bones, backs, wings and feet

steps: Put the bones in a large pot with the water and bring slowly to a simmer. Skim off the foam.
Simmer very gently, partly covered, for 6 hours.
Strain, salt to taste and chill. Lift the fat off and keep it for cooking. The broth sets to a jelly when cold.

recipes.title: Lamb Bone Broth
steps: Roast the bones at 220 °C for 30 minutes.
Simmer in the water for 6 hours, skimming now and then.
Strain, season and cool. Remove the fat once set.

recipes.title: Beef Broth Egg Drop Soup
steps: Bring the broth to a simmer and season with the salt.
Beat the eggs. Stir the broth in a circle and pour in the eggs in a thin stream.
Leave 30 seconds, then stir gently once so the egg forms ribbons.

recipes.title: Salmon Belly Strips
steps: Cut the belly into strips and salt them. Leave 15 minutes and pat dry.
Cook skin side down in a hot dry pan until crisp, about 5 minutes, then turn for 1-2 minutes. Finish with the black pepper.

recipes.title: Butter-Basted Cod
steps: Salt the cod and leave 10 minutes. Dry well.
